mailbox.description: The mailbox observed. One instance watches one mailbox.

max_message_bytes.description: Largest message fetched whole. A larger one is observed by its header and marked truncated.

max_attachment_bytes.description: Largest attachment stored as a blob. A larger one is described without its bytes.

batch.description: Messages fetched before committing and looking around.

import_history.description: Observe what is already in the mailbox on first connection. Off by default: a first run records the boundary and observes arrivals.

from.description: The address outgoing mail is sent from, envelope and header both. Defaults to the credential's username, which for iCloud is the account's address.

display_name.description: The display name outgoing mail carries beside the address.
